n00387d8fc1.summary: Mining and commodities trader Glencore said it set aside $1.5 billion as it expects to resolve corruption investigations.

nb1861ee3ee.headline: Canada Joins Lebanon and Turkey in 'Bitcoin's Marketing Team'
nb1861ee3ee.summary: Canada's Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister said banks could be asked to immediately freeze or suspend individuals' bank accounts as truck drivers' protests against coronavirus restrictions continue.

ne79cb9aeee.headline: Rupee decline persists, currency drops to Rs175.78
ne79cb9aeee.summary: The rupee's decline continued, falling to Rs175.78 against the dollar. It has depreciated 11.57 percent since July 1, 2021, and an analyst expects consolidation at this level.
ne79cb9aeee.why: The rupee's value affects Pakistan's import costs, inflation and its foreign-currency debt servicing, which matter for emerging-market investors.
ne79cb9aeee.why_moved: The input cites uncertainty in geopolitical conditions and rising oil prices as drivers of the rupee's continued decline.

n603ac637ea.why: Anti-money laundering rules affect financial-crime compliance costs and the attractiveness of London as a financial centre.

nab250a285d.headline: BNR publicly reaffirms commitment to July 2021 updated version of Global FX Code

nab250a285d.why: The Global FX Code sets voluntary standards for conduct in foreign exchange markets, which central banks and market participants use to govern trading practices.
